faq.question: Is a Master’s in Automobile Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Master’s in Automobile Engineering is not listed in the University of Mauritius’s published 2026–2027 postgraduate programme catalogue. The university does offer related engineering and management programmes.

faq.question: Which university can I contact for related engineering programmes?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius is a starting point. Review its Mechanical and Production Engineering Department listings and ask about postgraduate research opportunities relevant to automotive technology.

faq.question: What is the estimated cost of living in Mauritius?
faq.answer: An indicative student budget is MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, approximately ₹30,000–₹50,000 using the exchange rate assumed in this article. Actual costs depend on accommodation and lifestyle.

faq.question: Can Indian students apply for related engineering programmes in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian applicants should check the institution’s international admission requirements, accepted qualifications, fees and applicable study-permit rules before applying.

faq.question: What career options are available after a related master’s degree?
faq.answer: Depending on your specialisation and experience, possible areas include automotive design, vehicle testing, electric vehicle systems, manufacturing, quality assurance and mechanical engineering. Verify that the programme provides the technical training required for your chosen role.
